hypothesis: Question posed in the brief: can a submission beat 0.3195 (DARD, live rank 9) or 0.4133 (xiaofanhu, live rank 1)? Answered negatively for this lane. No new raster was produced.
mechanism: Bedrock-channel steepness (ksn) and chi-transform knickpoints record rock-uplift gradients across active normal faults (Kirby & Whipple 2012). Chi transform per Perron & Royden (2013). Segmentation per Gailleton et al. (2019).
named_non_fault_mimic: Lithologic contrasts (resistant over weak rock) and base-level steps from playas or ephemeral channels both create steepness steps without faulting.
